chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

Whoever frees a believing slave, Allah will free a limb of his from the Fire for every limb of the slave. And if it is a female slave, Allah will free one limb of his from the Fire for every two limbs of hers, because a woman is half of a man.

key_terms.أَعْتَقَ: set free or emancipated from bondage
key_terms.عُضْوٍ: a bodily limb, used here in measuring the reward
key_terms.مُؤْمِنًا: a believing person, here meaning a believer held in slavery
key_terms.ٱلنَّارِ: the Fire, meaning Hellfire in the Hereafter
key_terms.ٱلْمَرْأَةَ: the woman, mentioned here in legal comparative valuation

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for freeing a believing slave in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great reward for emancipating a believing slave, linking each limb freed in this world to deliverance from the Fire in the Hereafter. It also gives a legal valuation distinction between male and female slaves within the ruling context of emancipation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3433 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace be upon him and his family, said:

"Whoever frees a believing slave, Allah (swt) will free a limb of his from the Fire for every limb of the slave. And if it is a female slave, Allah (swt) will free two limbs of his for every limb of hers from the Fire, because a woman is equal to half of a man."
